title: In-Person Appointments No-Show Fee: Addition for Long-Held Slots
content:
**Fee schedule supplement: slots held for the patient.** A sum is added to the no-show fee a missed In-Person Appointments visit carries according to how long the missed slot was held for the patient:

| Days the missed slot was held for the patient | Added to the no-show fee the missed visit carries |
|---|---|
| 90 or more | 25.00 dollars |
| 60 to 89 | 15.00 dollars |
| fewer than 60 | nothing |

The days held run up to the scheduled date of the missed visit. A slot is first held for the patient on the booking date shown on the appointment record.

**Edges (hypothetical holds).** Held 90 days: 25.00 dollars. Held 89 days: 15.00 dollars. Held 60 days: 15.00 dollars. Held 59 days: nothing.

*Illustration (hypothetical):* an Annual Preventive Exam booked on 2026-03-02 for 2026-06-15, never moved and never confirmed, was held 105 days, so 25.00 dollars are added.
